ov: Earthworms are soil-dwelling annelids, among nature’s most important recyclers of dead plant matter. They have no skeleton and breathe through their moist skin.
df: Dead plant matter and other organic material in the soil.
fx: Earthworms are food for many animals, from moles and blackbirds to wild boar.
